description: Web Page to Markdown API: Get a web page as Markdown. The main content of a public web page as clean Markdown, with its title, metadata and links. Redirects are followed (up to 5). `render=true` runs the page's JavaScript in a headless browser and waits for anti-bot checks. Errors are free: `render_required` and `empty_page` (400) say when to retry with `render=true`; `page_not_found` (404), `page_access_denied`, `page_unavailable`, `page_too_large`, `unsupported_content_type` (400). Price: 2 credits per call, 10 with render=true; failed calls are free.

include_html.description: Also return the raw HTML of the page (`html`)

include_text.description: Also return the main content as plain text (`text`)

render.description: Load the page in a headless browser (JavaScript, anti-bot checks): 10 credits instead of 2

url.description: The public http(s) URL of the page

name: web_page
title: Get a web page as Markdown
